category_edits.rationale: Cap each consumed item embedding's effective L2 norm at 1 to reduce item-norm dominance. Apply the same differentiable parameterization to histories, training targets, negatives, and inference candidates. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so inference automatically uses the same cap. Preserve embedding dimensions, GRU topology, scoring, loss, optimizer, and per-dataset checkpoints.

response.change_summary: Apply effective unit-ball norm capping consistently to the shared item embedding table in each category's single GRU model, including inference through the existing predictor's model-class import.
